selection.methodology: Translations of existing pillar states and R00–R06. No state is recomputed by this view.

brakes.eligibility: Available pillar translations outside the listed favorable state. UNAVAILABLE is never a market brake.

selection.stress: The already adjudicated STRESS pillar chooses level-trigger wording if actual VIX meets canonical v_stress using the frozen numeric tolerance; otherwise it describes the existing joint branch. This does not adjudicate, smooth or suppress STRESS.
selection.incomplete: Always a technical title with no economic fallback, support list or brake list. Pending source conditions and core missing reasons retain their true codes in details.

watch.economic: Names current canonical conditions whose change requires re-evaluation. No outcome, return, direction forecast or trade instruction.
watch.selective: Participation becoming favorable with other pillars unchanged.
watch.stress: Whether the existing STRESS condition still holds.
watch.defensive: The actual R02 or R03 participating pillar states.
watch.transition: Changes in participation/leadership and volatility/fragility combinations, without implying those pillars are currently unaligned.
watch.incomplete: Restore identified core source conditions/windows. Source restoration is not portrayed as a market event.

stressHeadings.reason: Avoid implying that favorable equity evidence activates STRESS or that the actual adverse volatility trigger holds STRESS back. Underlying claims, selection, attribution and R01 remain unchanged.

attribution.lineage: Equity claims cite all 11 actual sector ETF parents; VIX/VX/BTC/GLD cite their actual source-status keys. No SPY/RSP/IWM proxy substitution.
attribution.nulls: Remain missing, including unknown publication timestamps. Display formatting never creates zero from null.
attribution.numbers: Actual measurements may be rounded for readability; raw values remain exact in the view. Measurement percentages are units, not confidence/probability.

displayLimitations.historical: R2 reconstruction; no point-in-time OOS since 2019
displayLimitations.fixtures: Design/test scenarios with synthetic provenance, not a current market reading.
